limitations: Wednesday projections and roster positions are captured snapshot estimates, not final lineups.
Transactions cover the 25 visible captured rows (Nov 18–25), including five already present in the prior capture; this is not certified complete transaction history.
Raw capture page text, raw transaction text and URLs are excluded.
Captured page text is capped at 220000 characters and contains styles before player tables; raw row captures supply the actual verification evidence.
GP is the captured selected-period GP column, not verified season games played.
Actual rank is verified as shown and belongs to the selected stats filter; seasonRank is null.
Compact Bye rows have null points/projections rather than invented scores; additive lineup totals treat null as zero, and source facts retain null.
Player injury labels describe the capture snapshot; they do not prove historical injury status or future availability.
